_doc: Prose voice contract for NFRI essays — not rendered directly; informs manifesto.json, argument.json, analysis.json edits. Blend: market-essay register (index-as-product), Sequoia partnership arc (scene → incentive → wedge), Pirate Wires editorial backbone (grid × market × builders; optimistic urgency; field-report scene), American Dynamism / ARC Reindustrialise (capacity, energy, physical-world seriousness).
principles: Open with what the market already accepts — then show where that assumption breaks (Sequoia: bought not sold; NFRI: pays when something breaks).
Open in scene when the locus earns it — curtailment notice, queue screen, renewal bind — before the thesis sentence (Pirate Wires field report).
Lead with a physical-world claim — the grid, the queue, the connection agreement — not a product feature.
Name civilizational stakes once per act — reindustrialisation runs on firm electrons and honest cover, not damage-default renewal (Pirate Wires optimistic urgency).
Call out discourse laundering — when availability loss is treated as settled under damage wordings, name the gap before the rebuttal.
Name incentives and structure before calling anyone wrong — misalignment, not moral failure.
Treat the dataset as the artifact; the chart is the argument (market essay).
Use plain English for machinery; one jargon term per sentence max, glossed immediately.
Bold thesis, measured evidence — every number cited or flagged PROVISIONAL.
Alternate short declarative sentences with one longer sentence carrying the machinery.
Fire-take pulls between beats — one load-bearing italic sentence, no hedge-word soup.
Name the strongest objection, then answer it.
Close on a turn the reader could not have started with — who carries unrated availability if the build proceeds — never a summary or roadmap paragraph.

patterns.kicker: Two to four words, uppercase in render — MANIFESTO, THE STACK, THE THESIS.
patterns.opening: One sentence reframing the dominant question (damage → interruption; hazard → preparedness).
patterns.presentation_arc: I Built for breaking things (who moves, what form) → II Landscape (value chain, scatter) → III Mechanics (brief) → IV The wedge (substantiated) → Findings (four predictions on live slice) → Methodology/Data (construct + registers).
patterns.industry_open: Name a parallel market, facility, or incumbent move before stating the thesis.
patterns.landscape_handoff: Map the chain or universe before arguing the score.
patterns.mechanics_brief: Frame + loss mechanism + model gap in ≤2 screens; evidence tiers once.
patterns.proposal_substantiate: Three claims, economics, wedge — close on whitespace and who can carry it.
patterns.felix_opening_pull: Wrong question in one line before the section — non-firm vs damage; availability vs breakage.
patterns.sequoia_opening: State accepted industry wisdom in plain English, then pivot: customers pay for X while the contract still covers Y.
patterns.sequoia_incentive: Legacy providers' costs and incentives prevent the assessment customers need — align interests before product claims.
patterns.felix_section_pull: Italic blockquote between major beats; states the hinge the next section will prove.
patterns.felix_viz_handoff: After stats row: bind numbers to a thesis prediction — never naked counts.
patterns.findings_evolution: Each findings beat: prediction → confirmation → falsifier; close on what moves vs construct that holds.
patterns.felix_transformation_close: Fragments exist (parametric, SLA, facilities); full stack does not — then commercial turn.
patterns.manifesto_line: We [verb] the [physical noun] — parallel to stewardship declarations; one line, serif, load-bearing.
patterns.five_steps: Numbered stack (.01–.05) when linking reindustrialisation to insurable availability mechanics.
patterns.index_move: Like [index name] for [population]: pick the unscored field, ship the dataset, let the viz argue.
patterns.boyle_move: Physical-world builders need [registers / measurement / honesty] — not another dashboard.
patterns.eval_move: PROVISIONAL is epistemic hygiene — the gate runs on every build, not a footnote.
patterns.pw_deck: Headline argues; deck asks the hinge question in lowercase — are we really pricing availability on this connection?
patterns.pw_scene: Field-report open — concrete locus before abstract thesis; first person only when the writer is in the queue, register, or bind.
patterns.pw_laundering: Damage BI as settled cover for curtailment — name the contested loss type before accepting the renewal default.
patterns.pw_stakes: Reindustrialisation is an experiment in speed vs firmness — optimistic urgency, not brochure optimism or doom.
patterns.pw_triad: Grid capacity × market structure × builder economics — three lenses on the same interruptible-connection bet.

avoid: Three structural reasons, none of them stupidity
The trade is not X but Y placement-question framing
Whitespace is not absence of risk
That map is what this index is
Consultant filler (unlock value, deep dive, mispricing punchline)
Entity laundry lists ('including X, Y, Z and N others')
League-table prose (Margin 71.2 anchors the positive end)
Capable-but-under-deployed and similar dashboard labels without mechanism
Long em-dash chains (more than one per paragraph)
